label: cell body or cytoplasmic projection contraction
definition: A physiological phenotype in which a microbial cell actively contracts its body or a cytoplasmic projection, reducing its length or extension.
observations: Shortening parent; refined parents for existing v558/v604 child IDs.

label: stalk contraction
definition: A physiological phenotype in which a microbial cell actively reduces the end-to-end extension of its stalk.
observations: Active end-to-end extension reduction; no universal contour shortening or mechanism.
